in_arabic.name: Dzimaar
in_arabic.long_meaning: Dzimaar هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. In Arabic, Dzimaar means ‘the one who gathers’ or ‘the harvester’. This name is derived from the Arabic root ‘dzm’ meaning ‘to gather’. It is a powerful name for a boy, symbolizing the idea of collecting, accumulating, and bringing abundance into one's life. In the Islamic context, it can also be seen as a reference to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who gathered and brought the teachings of Islam to the world.
